crossRefs.note: God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
crossRefs.keyword: A.M. 3074. B.C. 930. (Title.) Maschil. or, A Psalm forAsaph, to give instruction

crossRefs.note: The Spirit of God came on Azariah the son of Oded:
Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when…
“Hear, you kings! Give ear, you princes! I, even I, will sing to Yahweh. I will sing praise to Yahweh, the God of…
“I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.
“Listen to me, my people; and hear me, my nation, for a law will go out from me, and I will establish my justice for a…
Turn your ear, and come to me. Hear, and your soul will live. I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the…
He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

translations.web: Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.
translations.bsb: Give ear, O my people, to my instruction; listen to the words of my mouth.
translations.kjv: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
translations.asv: Give ear, O my people, to my law: Incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
